fixtures.description: A bordered, padded, background-filled container with nine child blocks is far taller than the 240px page and FRAGMENTS across three pages (CSS Fragmentation 3 §3, class-A break between children). Under the default box-decoration-break:slice the box is sliced at each page edge: page 1 keeps the TOP border (open at the bottom), the middle page has NO top/bottom border (only the left/right edges), and the last page keeps the BOTTOM border (open at the top). The multi-page harness asserts the page COUNT (3) and diffs every page, so any clipping or mis-placed border fails — the first fixture that validates container fragmentation (splitting a box between its children), not just a single text block.

fixtures.description: A single paragraph far taller than the 200px page is SPLIT across page boundaries (CSS Fragmentation 3 §3): 24 lines at 16px/1.5 (18pt each, 8 per 150pt page) span THREE pages. The multi-page harness asserts the page COUNT (3) and diffs every page against Chrome, so any clipping or off-by-one split fails — the first fixture that validates layout-level fragmentation (line-box splitting), not just a forced break.
